name: @alandotcom/claude-plugins
description: Development tooling and tests for the Claude Code plugins in this repository.

scripts.build: esbuild plugins/recall/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=plugins/recall/dist/recall.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --test plugins/*/test/*.test.ts
